problem_statement: Enumerate all 1044 unlabelled graphs on 7 vertices, build each flag 2-skeleton (vertices + edges + triangular 3-cliques), compute integral homology via Smith normal form of boundary matrices d1,d2 to tabulate (b0,b1,b2, H1/H2 torsion invariant factors) for every case, and isolate a minimal 6-vertex RP2 triangulation facet list with SNF certificate of Z/2 torsion plus a logged greedy-collapse failure proving non-collapsibility.
